intent: Follow evening light from the meadow into woodland dusk, through lantern gardens, and out beneath a deep-blue sky.

sections.name: The late-afternoon meadow
sections.lesson: Hop through the last warm sunlight

signs.text:
The late-afternoon meadow
Hop through the last warm sunlight

The sunset path
Cross the sun-warmed garden stones

The dusk woodland edge
Keep below the darkening branches

The lantern gardens
Climb through the lit porticoes

sections.name: Under the deep-blue sky
sections.lesson: The final garden terrace opens to the stars

signs.text:
Under the deep-blue sky
The final garden terrace opens to the stars
